Port AGV

Multiagent path planning for a reinforcement-learning class. Three vehicles, one container each. Open this file — nothing else to install.

Original Python project — 30 held-out episodes

Success means all 3 containers delivered. Steps, collisions, delivered containers, and path length are averages per episode. A live run is one layout, so the counts will differ; the habits should match this ranking.

Press Play. The opening layout is a fixed draw so the six methods are easy to compare.

    Reward, per vehicle, until it delivers. −0.05 each step. +0.05 for every cell closer to the current target, and −0.05 for every cell farther. −2 if that vehicle is flagged in a collision. +1 on pickup. +10 on delivery, plus +2 to each teammate. Before pickup the target is its own container. After pickup the target is the berth line, and distance is the row number. Driving into a rack or off the map is blocked and is not a collision.

    Keys: Space play/pause · → step · N new layout · R restart · 1–6 methods. Switching method keeps this layout and continues from the current cells.
